results.text:
# IES Communications

IES Communications is a Telecommunications company. IES Communications provides customized network solutions and integration services for businesses and organizations. They offer a wide range of services including audio visual, audio systems, video walls, meetings and collaboration, control and automation, unified communications, iptv, broadcast, command centers, managed services and support, in-building wireless, mission-critical, hyperscale data center, colocation facilities, enterprise technical services (ets), security,. IES Communications employs 2,545 people (+29.6% YoY, +581 people) and has an annual revenue of $350M, founded in 1984. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, United States, with offices including Englewood, Phoenix, San Antonio, Bluffdale, and Sandston. Its workforce is distributed across 7 countries (including United States, France, Canada, Japan, and Puerto Rico).

## About

IES Communications, a division of IES Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: IESC), is a national technology infrastructure integrator. Our highly trained professionals design, deploy, integrate, and support customized network solutions that connect people, places, and technology.

With more than 40 years of experience, 5,000+ employees, and 25+ Communications division locations across the United States, IES Communications combines national resources with local accountability. Our certified teams support the complete technology lifecycle through system design, installment, sourcing, training, managed support, maintenance, and optimization.

Our integrated solutions include audio visual systems, structured cabling, in-building wireless coverage, integrated security, network infrastructure, and data center and mission-critical solutions. Mission-critical capabilities include hyperscale infrastructure, colocation management, enterprise technical services, high-density fiber, rack-and-stack deployments, infrastructure integration, migrations, commissioning, and ongoing technical support.

ABOUT IES COMMUNICATIONS

Founded in 1984, IES Communications has supported complex technology environments where performance, uptime, security, and coordination are essential. Our work is guided by disciplined safety and quality practices and six core values: Safety, Leadership, Quality, People, Teamwork, and Customer Service.

IES Communications serves as the technology integrator for enterprise campuses, healthcare organizations, hospitality venues, data centers, educational institutions, and government facilities nationwide.

properties.name: IES Holdings
properties.description:
IES Holdings, Inc. (formerly known as Integrated Electrical Services, Inc.) provides electrical contracting services to commercial, industrial, and residential customers in the United States. 

IES was founded in 1997 and is based in Houston, Texas.

Our business segments include:

- IES Commercial & Industrial (https://iesci.net)
- IES Communications (https://www.iescomm.com)
- IES Residential (https://www.iesresidential.com)
- IES Infrastructure (https://iesinfrastructure.com)
